legend: Giemsa-stained bone marrow smear shows immature basophils with irregular nuclei and coarse basophilic granules of varying sizes (<<29809>>). diagnosis: Acute basophilic leukaemia, flow cytometry dot plots
legend: Dot plots show the immunophenotype of blasts (red), immature and mature basophils (purple), lymphocytes (light blue), and granulocytes (brown). The blasts show relatively bright CD45 and heterogeneous CD34 (A), moderate to weak CD13 and KIT (CD117) (B), heterogeneous CD11b and negative HLA-DR (C), bright CD33 and negative CD25 (D), moderate CD123 and partial CD203c (E), and negative cytoplasmic myeloperoxidase and sCD22 (F) expression. Immature/mature basophils are highlighted with bright CD45 and negative CD34 (A), moderate CD13 and negative KIT (CD117) (B), moderate CD11b and negative HLA-DR (C), bright CD33 and CD25 (D), and bright CD123 and CD203c (E) expression.
